testChangeAssessment: Holding the actual PUT upload stage replaces a page.screenshot interception that the default project bitmap pipeline no longer calls. A bounded entered-stage wait now fails a stage that is never reached. Cancellation still asserts comment/body preservation and canonical version invalidation.
Ordinary page tests now require default Done, exact saved PNG/frame/source pairing and Send on the same page, matching the requested product behavior.

The blue-pixel centroid is altered by numeral cutouts and the speech bubble shape. The revised point tests use actual 28px hit-box center plus world/page coordinates as anchor authority and scan the entire PNG envelope.

The lower-body exclusion assertion conflicted with actual shadow/caption paint. Controlled before/after pixel measurement demonstrates a real contribution and the tests preserve the correct source reference.
Waiting for animation completion before final non-overlap does not remove motion checks: the same anchors are verified at 0,65,130,195,260 ms and under reduced motion.
validationLimits: This is an independent precise increment; the entire 190-test default suite and seven-material matrix were not rerun by this reviewer. Their separate executor records remain in full-checks.json and earlier evidence.
This increment used project Chromium 1193 / 140.0.7339.186 with the renderer sandbox enabled. It does not claim a new Safari, Edge or IAB run.
Native CEF, HTML controls/audio, OS clipboard and Keychain remain outside this review; no native helper was started.
